paragraphs: R' Pinhas ben Aruva. He said: ‘I was among the grandees of Rome when Titus died. They cut open his brain and found a gnat the size of a sparrow, weighing two selaim; some say, like a year-old pigeon [the cited baraita adds a weight of two litrin].’ Gittin 56b. R' Yohanan said in his name, Bekhorot 38b:19.
